title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Tier Schedule: Qualifying Basis, Poverty-Guideline Bands and Discount Percent
content:
The Patient Financial Assistance Program is offered at six tiers. Each tier is defined by what qualifies the applicant for it, by the band of household income it covers, stated as a percent of the federal poverty guideline, and by the percent of the eligible patient responsibility on each covered invoice that the tier discounts.

## Schedule

| Tier | Qualifying basis | Band starts above (percent of guideline) | Band ends at, inclusive (percent of guideline) | Discount percent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | Household income against the poverty guideline | 300 | 400 | 25 |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | Household income against the poverty guideline | 250 | 300 | 50 |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | Household income against the poverty guideline | 200 | 250 | 75 |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | Household income against the poverty guideline | 0 (band starts from zero income) | 200 | 100 |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | Enrollment in a qualifying program | 0 | 0 (income is not assessed) | 100 |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | Medical hardship | 0 (band starts from zero income) | 600 | 0 (the discount is computed by the hardship cap instead) |

The lower figure of each income band is exclusive, belonging to the band below, except where the band starts from zero income. The upper figure is inclusive.

| Tier | Assets assessed in addition to income | Tier assessed at intake may be changed before the decision when documents show a different band |
|---|---|---|
| Financial Assistance 25% Discount | No | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 50% Discount | No | Yes |
| Financial Assistance 75% Discount | No | Yes |
| Financial Assistance Full Discount | No | Yes |
| Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount | No | Yes |
| Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment | No | Yes |

## Reading the bands

- A household at exactly 300 percent of the guideline falls in the Financial Assistance 50% Discount band; at 300.1 percent it falls in the Financial Assistance 25% Discount band.
- A household at exactly 250 percent falls in the Financial Assistance 75% Discount band; at 250.1 percent, in the Financial Assistance 50% Discount band.
- A household at exactly 200 percent falls in the Financial Assistance Full Discount band; at 200.1 percent, in the Financial Assistance 75% Discount band.
- A household at exactly 400 percent falls in the Financial Assistance 25% Discount band; above 400 percent no income tier's band is met.
- The Presumptive Eligibility Full Discount carries no income band: its discount percent of 100 rests on program enrollment, not on a percent of the guideline.
- The Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment carries a discount percent of 0 because its discount is not a percent of each invoice; it is computed under the hardship cap.
